PTree.Interp.StateFacts.run_state_get
endpoints.type:
@StateFacts.run_state_get
     : forall (S : Type) (E MN : Type -> Type) (A : Type)
         (k : S -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A)
         (s : S),
       @PStruct.pstruct E MN (S * A) (S * A) (@eq (S * A))
         (@State.run_state S E MN A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) S
                  (@Sum.inl1 (State.stateE S) E S (State.Get S)) k
            |} s)
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.TauF E MN (S * A) (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A))
               (@State.run_state S E MN A (k s) s)
         |}

@StateFacts.run_state_put
     : forall (S : Type) (E MN : Type -> Type) (A : Type)
         (k : unit -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A)
         (s s' : S),
       @PStruct.pstruct E MN (S * A) (S * A) (@eq (S * A))
         (@State.run_state S E MN A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) unit
                  (@Sum.inl1 (State.stateE S) E unit (State.Put S s')) k
            |} s)
         {|
           PTreeDefinition._observe :=
             @PTreeDefinition.TauF E MN (S * A) (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A))
               (@State.run_state S E MN A (k tt) s')
         |}

     : forall (S : Type) (E MN : Type -> Type) (A X : Type) (e : E X)

         (s : S),

PTree.Execution.Backend.SubEnumQ.pick_interval_support
endpoints.type:
@SubEnumQ.pick_interval_support
     : forall (A : Type) (mu : list (rat.rat * A))
         (q : @order.Order.POrder.sort ssrnum.ring_display
                (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
                   rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)) (x : A),
       is_true
         (@order.Order.le ssrnum.ring_display
            (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
               rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)
            (@ssralg.GRing.zero
               (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.Num_POrderedZmodule__to__GRing_Nmodule
                  rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)) q) ->
       @SubEnumQ.pick_interval A mu q = @Some A x ->
       exists p : rat.rat,
         @List.In (rat.rat * A) (p, x) mu /\
         is_true
           (@order.Order.lt ssrnum.ring_display
              (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
                 rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)
              (@ssralg.GRing.zero
                 (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.Num_POrderedZmodule__to__GRing_Nmodule
                    rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)) p)

endpoints.name: PTree.Execution.Backend.SubEnumQ.pick_interval_missing
endpoints.type:
@SubEnumQ.pick_interval_missing
     : forall (A : Type) (mu : list (rat.rat * A))
         (q : @order.Order.POrder.sort ssrnum.ring_display
                (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
                   rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)),
       @FiniteEnum.finite_nonnegative rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain A mu ->
       is_true
         (@order.Order.le ssrnum.ring_display
            (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
               rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)
            (@ssralg.GRing.zero
               (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.Num_POrderedZmodule__to__GRing_Nmodule
                  rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_POrderedZmodule)) q) ->
       @SubEnumQ.pick_interval A mu q = @None A <->
       is_true
         (@order.Order.le ssrnum.ring_display
            (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__Order_POrder
               rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain)
            (@FiniteEnum.finite_expect rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain A
               (fun _ : A =>
                ssralg.GRing.one
                  (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__GRing_SemiRing
                     rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain)) mu) q)

endpoints.name: PTree.Execution.Backend.SubEnumQ.replay_sample_support
endpoints.type:
@SubEnumQ.replay_sample_support
     : forall (A : Type) (mu : Representation.SubEnumQ A) (q : SubEnumQ.quantile)
         (rest : list SubEnumQ.quantile) (x : A),
       @SubEnumQ.replay_sample A mu (q :: rest) = (@Runner.Drawn A x, rest) ->
       exists p : ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.sort rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain,
         @List.In (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.sort rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain * A) (
           p, x) (@Representation.subenumQ_data A mu) /\
         is_true
           (@order.Order.lt ssrnum.ring_display
              (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.join_Num_POrderedZmodule_between_GRing_Nmodule_and_Order_POrder
                 (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__Num_POrderedZmodule
                    rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain))
              (@ssralg.GRing.zero
                 (ssrnum.Num.POrderedZmodule.Exports.Num_POrderedZmodule__to__GRing_Nmodule
                    (ssrnum.Num.NumDomain.Exports.Num_NumDomain__to__Num_POrderedZmodule
                       rat.rat_rat__canonical__Num_NumDomain))) p)

     : forall (A : Type) (mu : Representation.SubEnumQ A) (q : SubEnumQ.quantile)
